name: Boot Sector
description: The boot bay of the facility. Lights on, nobody home.

name: Dynamic Loader
description: The cargo dock, where everything the facility runs is loaded first.

name: Drone Refit Assembly
description: Where the facility's drones are pressed again out of Xantrium, and a hopper waits for fuel.

name: Xantrium Fens
description: Open country past the refit plant: fens, lakes of toxic water, Xantrium on the hills, and a relay mast far off.

name: User Space
description: The recruits' quarters, the quartermaster's heap, and the syscall gate down to the kernel.

name: Kernel Space
description: Ring 0: a hall of many floors - a gallery, the scheduler's dais, the interrupt well - and your crontab.

name: The Stack
description: Under kernel space, frame under frame, the stack awash with overflow - crossed on its ceilings, upside down.

name: Aspiration Central
description: A city under rain, and the Metacron's spire over it: up its glass face in magboots, up the broken lift shaft inside, to the scheduler of schedulers.

name: Swap Partition
description: Below the boot bay, where pages go when there is no room for them.

name: Simulatron: Long Fens
description: The fens without an edge, made new each run: walk or fly to the relay mast 230 cells off.

name: Simulatron: Deep Swap
description: Swap space a floor at a time, each one new and deeper than the last.

name: Simulatron: Swap Sprawl
description: Swap space with no walls round it: rooms for ever, the exit a few rooms off.

name: Simulatron: Kill House
description: A training program: four rooms, four kinds of squad.

name: Simulatron: Bus Run
description: A training program, played in real time.

name: Simulatron: Purge
description: A training program, played in real time.

name: Simulatron: Xantrium Rush
description: A training program, played in real time.

name: Simulatron: Fen Hopper
description: A training program, flown in real time.

name: Simulatron: Coolant Loop
description: A training program: a reactor through a shift.

name: Simulatron: Root Shell
description: A training program: card duels in the shell.

name: Simulatron: Deep Works
description: A training program: magboots, stairs, a jetpack, the water and a submarine.

name: Simulatron: Stairwell
description: A training program: real stairs, a mezzanine, a pump pit - the rooms drawn as they stand.
